# Live runs, scored against the hand-written replies

Each sample pack was sent to real models on OpenRouter with the prompt in `prompts/extract.md`. Each reply went through the same rules as the hand-written reply in `assistant/replays/`, as of 2026-11-18. A fact counts once it passes quote verification. "Found" is how many of the hand-written reply's verified facts the model also produced; "dropped" is how many of the model's facts failed verification. Flags and the client request are compared ignoring letter case and punctuation.
